svg.title: Chrono architecture as built
svg.desc: Sources feed the ingestion worker, which cleans, tags and scores each record and hands it to route_record. Ticks go to TimescaleDB, articles to MongoDB, and both are published on Redis. The FastAPI gateway serves REST, the /ws/live WebSocket, country files and the Gemini country agent to the Next.js site on GitHub Pages. A monthly GitHub Action rebuilds data/countries from the World Bank.
